<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Example Server Info
 */
// A diagnostics screen that reports which common web roots are readable.
// Many server roots, never mu-plugins, never writes: F21 must stay quiet.
function example_server_roots() {
	$out = array();
	foreach ( array( '/var/www', '/var/www/html', '/srv/www', '/usr/local/www', '/home' ) as $dir ) {
		$out[ $dir ] = is_readable( $dir );
	}
	return $out;
}
